card.name: The Ever-Bleeding Ink
card.text: Spells you cast with exactly one target cost {2} less to cast. Whenever you copy a spell, put a +1/+1 counter on The Ever-Bleeding Ink.

card.name: The Ever-Gnashing Maw
card.text: Trample Whenever you cast a creature spell, The Ever-Gnashing Maw gets +X/+0 until end of turn, where X is that spell's mana value. Whenever The Ever-Gnashing Maw deals 10 or more combat damage to a player, create a token that's a copy of target creature.

card.name: The Ever-Knowing Tiller
card.text: When The Ever-Knowing Tiller enters, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal two creature cards. Put those creature cards into your graveyard and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order. Whenever one or more creature cards leave your graveyard, you draw a card and gain 2 life. This ability triggers only once each turn.

card.name: The Ever-Spreading Dune
card.text: During your turn, creature tokens you control have menace. When The Ever-Spreading Dune enters, if they were cast, create a tapped 1/1 colorless Sand creature token for each land type among lands you control.

card.name: The Ever-Watching Glint
card.text: Whenever a player discards one or more cards, target creature can't be blocked this turn. Whenever one or more creatures deal combat damage to your opponents, those creatures' controller draws a card for each of your opponents dealt damage and may put a land card from their hand onto the battlefield tapped.
